fields.name: texturePresets
fields.doc: Texture quality overrides by image URI or #image-index (FBX: #texture-id). Other images inherit the model/project preset and retain their cached work.

fields.name: lodCount
fields.doc: Maximum LODs including the original (1–8). Skin/morph meshes retain at most four.

fields.name: lodError
fields.doc: Relative simplification error ceiling; skin/morph meshes clamp this to 1%.

fields.name: virtualGeometry
fields.doc: Cook a versioned virtual-geometry DAG for each static material primitive. Skinned and morph-deformed meshes retain the classic path.

fields.name: opacityMaps
fields.doc: glTF base-color image URI (or #image-index) to companion opacity image URI. The mask's red channel multiplies existing alpha; paths are relative to the model.
